description.value: You know how to make even the Docks feel safer than they are. While you're actively mediating a negotiation between two hostile parties, both take a -1 circumstance penalty to Initiative rolls made against each other for as long as the negotiation continues.

cinderfall.incomplete: The -1 Initiative penalty applies to two OTHER creatures' rolls against each other while the holder mediates. This imposes a penalty or effect on another creature's own roll rather than modifying the card holder's, which a passive FlatModifier can't reach without a granted aura effect -- no such aura precedent exists anywhere in this corpus.
